delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.lead: Hand-delivered in the black ROYA box across the UAE. Worldwide by insured courier.
delivery.body: Inside the UAE, white-glove delivery is complimentary: your order is hand-delivered in the black ROYA box, and a bridal gown follows after the final fitting. You can also collect from the atelier by appointment. Outside the UAE, orders travel door to door by insured courier; the courier's fee is shown at checkout, and duties and taxes, if any, are paid on delivery.

alterations.title: Alterations
alterations.lead: Fittings are included until it is perfect.
alterations.body: A bespoke gown is fitted at the atelier or at your home, as many times as it takes. A ready-to-wear gown such as Noir has its hem adjusted at no charge. For anything else, message the designer.

sizing.title: Size & measurements
sizing.lead: Atelier sizes, or made to measure.
sizing.body: Ready-to-wear gowns come in the atelier sizes FR 34 to FR 44. A bespoke gown is made to measure: the designer takes your measurements at your first fitting, at the atelier or at your home, and keeps them privately on file for every future order. If you are between sizes, message the designer and she will advise.

care.title: Garment care
care.lead: Delivered in tissue, in the black ROYA box.
care.body: Store your gown flat in its tissue. Spot-clean only, and steam gently from the inside on a low heat. If you are unsure, ask the designer before you do anything else.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We keep what we need to make and deliver your order: your name, contact details, delivery address and, for a bespoke gown, your measurements. Measurements are visible only to you and the atelier team. We email about your order and your account; marketing emails are sent only if you join the private list, and every one carries an unsubscribe link. Card details are never held by us.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.body: Prices are in dirhams (AED) and include 5% UAE VAT. A bespoke gown begins with a deposit, which is non-refundable once the fabric is cut, and the balance is settled at the final fitting. Ready-to-wear pieces are described on their pages, and the designer will help with any question before you order. By placing an order you agree to these terms.
